snippet.title: SALVO - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Experience cinematic space warfare in SALVO, an action packed real-time tactical combat simulator. Command your flagship and engage in intense battles in a war-torn solar system. Play a story-driven campaign, or forge your own destiny across the dangerous frontiers.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4076880/SALVO/
